sections.start: Front and back pocket measurements of men’s and women’s jeans from popular brands.
sections.how: 介绍测量对象并给出全文总判断：女裤前袋约为男裤的58%，且价格、版型和品牌都解释不了。

sections.start: Every pair in the file was measured the same way: the deepest point of the front pocket, the widest and narrowest points of its opening, and the same four numbers for the back pocket.
sections.serves: Measured with the same tape on both departments, the average women’s front pocket is about 58% the size of the average men’s — and price, cut and brand explain none of it.
sections.how: 用80条裤子的前袋深度分布显示男女几乎不重叠，且女裤最深仍浅于男裤中位数，证明差距真实且巨大。

sections.start: Women’s front pockets are almost as wide as men’s — 15.18 cm against 16.37 cm, or 0.928 of the men’s width.
sections.serves: Measured with the same tape on both departments, the average women’s front pocket is about 58% the size of the average men’s — and price, cut and brand explain none of it.
sections.how: 把面积拆成宽×深，显示宽度差距小、深度差距大，面积比0.576，说明58%的缺口主要来自深度。

sections.start: The same tape measure on the back pockets finds two departments that are practically even: men’s average 16.01 × 13.70 cm for 219.7 cm², women’s 15.12 × 13.34 cm for 201.8 cm².
sections.serves: It is the vertical measurement that collapses: 14.33 cm against 23.13 cm, only 0.619 of the men’s depth.
sections.how: 用后袋几乎持平反衬前袋的垂直塌陷，排除整体布料/后袋同幅缩水，强化前袋深度问题。

sections.start: Split the file by brand and the pattern never breaks: in all 19 brands measured in both departments, the men’s front pockets average deeper than the women’s.
sections.serves: Measured with the same tape on both departments, the average women’s front pocket is about 58% the size of the average men’s — and price, cut and brand explain none of it.
sections.how: 逐品牌比较显示19个双部门品牌全部男裤前袋更深，证明品牌不能解释差距。

sections.start: Skinny jeans are the usual suspect, but the measurements do not support it.
sections.serves: Measured with the same tape on both departments, the average women’s front pocket is about 58% the size of the average men’s — and price, cut and brand explain none of it.
sections.how: 比较女裤三种版型和男裤五种版型，版型内差异仅约0.2–2.4 cm，远小于男女部门间8.8 cm，排除版型解释。

sections.start: The two halves of the sample cost the same: men’s pairs average $81.18 (from $39.99 to $209.00) and women’s $80.32 (from $9.99 to $249.00).
sections.serves: Measured with the same tape on both departments, the average women’s front pocket is about 58% the size of the average men’s — and price, cut and brand explain none of it.
sections.how: 显示男女样本均价相近且前袋面积与价格相关性接近零/略负，排除价格解释。

sections.start: Take the phone seriously as a yardstick and the counts are stark.
sections.serves: Width is never what stops a phone going in: the narrowest point of the opening is at least 11.0 cm on all 80 pairs.
sections.how: 用15–17 cm手机作尺度统计可放入数量，并确认所有口袋宽度足够、深度才是唯一障碍，具体化前袋深度差的后果。

sections.start: All 80 pairs, every number in the file.
sections.how: 汇总全部80条裤子的测量，补充前袋面积算法、铆钉高度和镂空标记计数。
